payload.core_composition_summary: First phase uses greedy with sorting to select distinct counts maximizing total size. Second phase uses greedy with priority queue to assign counts to types maximizing sum of min(f,count).
payload.rationale: The solution clearly separates into two coordinated greedy stages, first sorting and greedy selection of distinct counts, then using a max-heap to greedily assign these counts to types for secondary objective.
